newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung rebounds as uncertainty removed.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung rebounds as uncertainty removed.

text.p: Shares in ceramics and machinery maker Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd rebounded sharply after the company said the shutdown of a plant in Germany would not affect a planned spinoff of a subsidiary in the United States, brokers said on Tuesday.

"Renewed speculation of an exceptional gain from spinning off its unit after the company said its plan would not be affected fueled short term buying interest," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage.
Siu-Fung shares rose HK$0.10 or 13.16 percent to a session high of HK$0.86 before steadying at HK$0.83 in late morning.
